considerations: Scope results to known Drupal hosts and established sites. New installations, deployments and configuration management can write this file legitimately.
Compare its change time and content to the deployment record. Corroborate unexpected database-setting or administrator changes with web and application audit logs.
This covers a subset of CVE-2026-132165 behavior. The publisher does not report settings.php modifications in the live cases cited by the advisory.
description: Find a web or PHP worker writing Drupal's per-site settings file, a lead for the installer abuse described in CVE-2026-132165.

evidence.claim: The Drupal Security Team received a report of live exploitation starting November 19. The team identifies settings.php writability by the web server as a condition for some exploitation paths. The hunt infers a file-write signal from this condition.

expected_output: One row per matching file operation, with the host, path, process and file hash when collected.

history.summary: Created evidence-backed hunt and validated all supported variants.

hypothesis: A web worker unexpectedly writing an existing site's settings.php may indicate attempted reinstallation or configuration tampering.
performance: Time filter first, then table-specific predicates and a narrow projection.
scope: Evidence review, static checks, Microsoft Kusto syntax and schema analysis. Engine and workspace execution not run.
title: Drupal Web Workers Writing Site Settings

1.json:
DeviceFileEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where ActionType in~ ("FileCreated", "FileModified", "FileRenamed") and FileName =~ "settings.php"
| where FolderPath matches regex @"(?i)(?:^|[/\\])sites[/\\][^/\\]+(?:[/\\]settings[.]php)?[/\\]?$"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("w3wp.exe", "php.exe", "php-cgi.exe", "php-cgi", "httpd.exe", "httpd", "apache2") or InitiatingProcessFileName startswith "php-fpm"
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, ActionType, FileName, FolderPath, InitiatingProcessFileName, SHA256
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| summarize Results = make_list(pack_all())
| project JSON = tostring(Results)
